name: official
readout: single-query retrieval, gap selection then render
aggregation: query mean within image -> mean over images -> mean over scenes (macro)
notes: Any number under P1 is comparable to 64.01. Naive flat mean over the 208 rows gives ~0.63, not 0.6401.

name: in-harness single candidate
readout: one candidate per query (rank-1 of the NAG score order); no gap set
aggregation: query mean within image -> image mean -> scene mean
notes: Diagnostic only. Never compare to P1: the gap set is what supplies most of the 0.64.

name: Gaussian Grouping
readout: single-query retrieval on held-out test views
aggregation: mean over views per prompt -> mean over prompts
notes: Pure-CLIP retrieval; no class denominator. BIoU uses dilation_ratio=0.02.

name: set / prefix
readout: choose k from the candidate prefix, then render
notes: Gap rule already equals the global best fixed k (figurines k=1, ramen k=2). Different readout from P3; do not mix 0.6800 and 0.6660.

name: K19 pooled
readout: multi-class argmax over 19 NYU40 classes per root superpoint
aggregation: pool intersection/union per class over scenes, then mean over the 18 present classes
notes: bookshelf has 0 GT points in all 10 scenes. Fixed 19-divisor: multiply means by 18/19.

name: macro
aggregation: per scene mean over classes present in that scene, then mean over 10 scenes
notes: Not interchangeable with P5. OpenGaussian additionally drops sigmoid(opacity)<0.1 and forces pred=0 where gt=0; we do neither.

name: offline probe pipeline
readout: root-superpoint reasoning with exported features and GT labels
notes: For relative comparisons only. The offline base sits ~4-7 points above the official 40.79; absolute values are not comparable to P5.

name: official
scenes_samples: 5 scenes (bed, bench, lawn, room, sofa), resolution r4
notes: Protocol verified: per-Gaussian oracle 0.9594 matches the paper's 94.4. The 22-point gap is feature resolution (masks per view), not protocol.

name: 2D mask retrieval proxy
readout: rank the pipeline own SAM mask pool by CLIP vs by Grounded-SAM
aggregation: per query; no image or scene aggregation
notes: 2D only: no 3D lift, no render, no mIoU. Not comparable to P1 or P3.
